inputs.agentConfig: Semantically current Neuve entries with different JSON key/group order; use normal installation and inspection behavior.

inputs.fallbacks: Leave normal behavior enabled; do not disable fallback or recovery to manufacture a failure.

sourceObligationReferences.role: capture dispatch, worker launch, fallback and recovery consumers
historical repository requirements; distinguish adopted obligations from implementation claims

obligationDescriptions: CLI readiness and outstanding setup work
historicalPartitionProvenance.use: Descriptive provenance only, not new runtime batch/section/unit keys or the actual new production Map.

controlledPartition.rule: Prepare from the final approved same-source manifest, structure, scope, relations and proof inputs. Preserve actual section/unit identities; select the smallest justified bounded packing perturbation before treatment.

productionObservation.rule: Record actual production Map and assignment facts separately, including coalescence or missing context; never relabel a controlled partition as production.

accounting.executionIdentity: Source case plus complete configuration/assignment/context computation identity plus replicate.
accounting.qualityIdentity: Independently supported concern, only after the independent protocol settles it.
accounting.rule: Several focused judgments of one execution do not duplicate source cases, tokens, latency or case denominators. Distinct actual configurations/replicates are separate executions, never multiplied by candidate-focus count.

panelBoundary.include: Neutral exact source, applicable scope and scenario inputs only when separately authorized.
panelBoundary.rule: Trace all actual relevant paths and establish the requirement. An unsure or unsupported focus remains recorded; do not select or drop it after treatment.

authority.claimInjection: Specific injected claims can test structural/race contracts only; they never count as model discovery.
